summary: Pre-launch backend smoke test for AI Advocate: 16/16 critical user-facing flows PASS on LIVE backend (https://ai-law-guide-1.preview.emergentagent.com). Stripe LIVE checkout URLs now produced (cs_live_*), Lex chat returns Anthropic response in <30s, demo mode seeds Sarah v. Acme case with 3 items, admin endpoints (suggestions inbox PATCH/DELETE, solicitor-brief.pdf, waitlist) all functional, terms v1.4 + privacy v1.1 served. NO 5xx encountered. SAFE TO DEPLOY from a backend standpoint.

minor.issue: Review request listed POST /api/waitlist but actual endpoint is POST /api/waitlist/join. Admin export is GET /api/admin/waitlist (and /api/admin/waitlist.csv), not /api/waitlist/export. Frontend already uses the correct paths, but worth noting for docs.

action_items: Item 7 (Files-vs-Cases explainer modal — 'What are My Legal Files?' only, with 'vs.' comparison line, Got It button) was NOT verified because testing scope was backend-only. Main agent should self-verify in the web preview OR request a separate frontend pass.
Optional: align review-request endpoint names with actual server paths (waitlist join + admin waitlist export) in any external API docs.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 7551 lines — the router-split recommendation from iter18/19/20 is still outstanding. Pre-launch is not the time to refactor, but flag for post-launch.
TokenResp field is `access_token` (not `token` as the review-request implied). Frontend already uses the correct field. Tests had to be corrected during this run.
GET /api/cases returns {cases: [...]} envelope while many other list endpoints return raw arrays — minor inconsistency, low priority.
Demo case items_count=3 matches the requirement. Seed is idempotent per /api/auth/demo call (collections wiped + reseeded each time per test_credentials.md).
test_credentials: admin@aiadvocate.co.uk / AdminLex2026!  (verified is_owner=true)  |  Demo via POST /api/auth/demo (no body)
seed_data_creation: Each pytest run creates: 1 demo user session (auto-reseeded), 1 TEST_smoke_<uuid>@advocate.app signup user (persists), 1 TEST_wl_<uuid>@advocate.app waitlist entry (persists), 1 suggestion that is auto-deleted by the test (PATCH then DELETE). Net DB growth per run: 1 user + 1 waitlist row. Safe.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 16 launch-blocker smoke checks pass: demo mode + signup + admin login + Lex chat (Anthropic live, ~5-15s) + emergency contacts CRUD + watch token + feedback suggest + admin suggestions (GET/PATCH/DELETE) + solicitor-brief.pdf (%PDF-1.x bytes) + 401 interceptor + Stripe topup LIVE checkout URL (cs_live_*) + case timeline + case export-pdf + waitlist join + admin waitlist + terms v1.4 + privacy v1.1. Stripe is now CONFIGURED (was unconfigured in iter20). Backend is GREEN for deploy. The only remaining unverified item is review-request #7 (Files-vs-Cases explainer modal) which is a pure frontend modal-content check — main agent can eyeball this in 30 seconds in the web preview.
rca of the issue: No blockers. Initial test failures were test-code bugs (field name was access_token not token, /api/cases returns {cases:[]} envelope, case.name not case.title) — all corrected. Product code is healthy.
